subject: Next: Pilot readiness, data parity & prompt calibration
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
To: Alex Green <alex@brightpath.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Next: Pilot readiness, data parity & prompt calibration

Hi Alex — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we have a single reference. Let me know if I missed anything.

High-level goal:
- Prove that Redwood inference can reduce inference cost by >= 40% and maintain >= 0.9 label-level accuracy on your intent classification/slot extraction flows (initial evaluation focused on customer support triage).

Pain points you mentioned:
- Latency spikes during high-concurrency window (30k reqs/day)
- Model drift on niche product categories causing misrouting
- High per-token cost for large-batch nightly processing

Scope for initial pilot (30 days):
- Dataset: 100k anonymized support transcripts (you said you can provide a 10k sample first)
- Models: run three model variants (baseline, q8 quantized variant, cache-optimized variant)
- Metrics: mean latency P95 < 200ms, throughput 150 reqs/s sustained, top-1 routing accuracy >= 0.90 on eval prompt set
- Success gates: automated eval pass on our prompt-suite + no PII leakage on sampled outputs

Owners / roles:
- BrightPath: Alex Green (technical sponsor), Data Engineering for access
- Redwood: Rafael Mendes (eng lead), Ben Carter (inference engineer), Monica Patel (CS lead)

Access & setup asks (what we need from you to start):
1) Sample export (CSV) with schema and 500–1,000 anonymized rows for parity checks [attachment: brightpath-sample-schema.csv]
2) Network access: temporary read-only S3 bucket role OR secure scp transfer; if VPC peering is needed, please flag network point of contact
3) A short list of guarded labels (PII fields) that must be redacted
4) PO/contract path and expected procurement lead/timeframe (we can run an MSA redline in parallel)

Deliverables & timeline (proposed):
- Week 0 (this week): sample transfer + pilot charter sign-off
- Week 1: environment provisioning + model onboarding + prompt-suite definition
- Week 2: initial runs & parity checks; iterate prompt calibration
- Week 3–4: focused evals, SLA smoke tests, handoff to your SRE for integration tests

Attachments: pilot-charter-v1.pdf (outline + eval plan).

Proposed pilot kickoff: Monday, 21 Jun 2026 — if that works, we'll send a calendar invite and a short MRR/commencement note for your procurement team.

Thanks — Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
r[email redacted]@redwood.com

From: Alex Green <alex@brightpath.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2026 12:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next: Pilot readiness, data parity & prompt calibration

Thanks Rafael — that summary is spot on. A couple clarifications from our side: 

- We'll generate a 1,000-row anonymized sample by EOD tomorrow. We'll remove explicit PII but keep synthetic identifiers so you can validate parity.
- Procurement: we need a short form SOW + cost estimate. I don't expect a full PO before the kickoff but FYI our procurement lead is Cara Winters (cara.winters@brightpath.ai).
- Compliance: our security team requires an initial data handling attestation and a redaction checklist before any S3 access. Can Redwood share a short SOC2 export and your standard data handling appendix?

We are comfortable with the pilot scope; the one ask is that we include a small production-like bucket (50K rows) in week 3 if early results look promising — that's conditional on PO approval.

I'll attach the sample schema and a sanitized sample in my next email.

— Alex
Alex Green
Head of ML Ops | BrightPath AI
alex@brightpath.ai

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
To: Alex Green <alex@brightpath.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2026 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next: Pilot readiness, data parity & prompt calibration

Appreciate that, Alex. Two quick items from our side and an internal split of work so expectations are clear.

Action items (Redwood):
- Rafael: share SOC2 summary + data handling appendix (I'll attach to the HubSpot deal).
- Ben: lead data ingestion and parity validation, build anonymization checks and PII detectors.
- Monica: own kickoff coordination and success criteria sign-off with your PM.

Requests for BrightPath for Week 0:
1) Send the sanitized sample to secure-transfer@redwood.com or provide a presigned S3 path.
2) Confirm network preference (S3 presigned vs. temporary role vs. VPC peering).
3) Procurement contact (Cara) — if you can intro Cara to Monica that will speed contracting.

Tentative timeline update (if we receive sample by Tue 15 Jun):
- Tue 16 Jun: environment ready + initial data parity report by Ben
- Wed 17 Jun: first model onboarding + baseline run
- Mon 21 Jun: formal kickoff and weekly cadence established

I've added the HubSpot link to the deal record for visibility: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/473. I'll also drop the pilot-charter and data appendix in the DocuSign/drive link for your procurement to review: https://www.docusign.com/Member/PowerForm/view?alias=BP-MSA-Redline-2026

[Attachment: pilot-charter-v1.pdf]

If Ben or Monica want to call out anything technical now, feel free to reply — otherwise I'll send a calendar invite for the 21 Jun kickoff and an initial runbook.

Thanks — Rafael

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2026 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next: Pilot readiness, data parity & prompt calibration

I'll own ingestion and parity checks. Quick plan:
- Day 0 (on sample): run schema validation, field-level entropy check, spot-check for label distribution differences vs. your reported breakdown.
- Day 1: spin up q8 quantized variant + baseline; run 500-sample prompt-suite to surface obvious drift.
- Deliverable: short parity report (CSV + notes) and a Jupyter that highlights 10 failure cases for prompt tuning.

Monica — can you schedule a 30-min sync with Alex's procurement (Cara) and add the SOW from Rafael? I'll need the sample by EOD Tue to keep the schedule.

Ben
